sentences.text: For Petitioner : Mr.R.Manickavel  For R1 & R2 : Mr.R.Gokul Krishnan  Additional Government Pleader
For R3 : M/s.P.Veena Suresh  ORDER

This Writ Petition has been filed for a Mandamus to direct the respondents to determine the compensation payable for the residential plot bearing Plot.No.105, Vivekanandhar Nagar, Ponneri,
Thiruvallur, comprised in S.Nos.65 and 67, as per Patta No.1578, S.No.65/39 and 67/42 of Attanthangal Village, Ponneri Taluk, measuring 1815 Sq.ft., acquired in pursuant to the notice dated 13.11.2006 in Ref.No.Na.Ka.76/2005/m1 issued by the first respondent under Section 4 (1) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 for the formation of Outer Ring Road by the CMDA under the provisions of the Right To Fair Compensation and Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013 and pay the compensation under the said Act.
____________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2.
When the matter was taken up for hearing it is submitted that the Award has been passed and therefore, the relief sought for in the present Writ Petition has become infructuous.
3. The learned counsel for the Petitioner on the other hand would submit that he came to know about the Award that has been passed only when the counter affidavit has been filed.

4. In view of the above, Writ Petition is disposed of by directing the Respondents to refer the matter to the Competent Court under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 as expeditiously as possible within a period of three (3) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this Order.
No costs.
